setup.title: setup wizard
setup.alreadyComplete: Setup is already marked complete. Re-running the wizard will overwrite scenario / infra labels and add a fresh embed origin, but won't touch existing tokens or data.
setup.persisted: Configuration is stored in the local database. You can re-run this wizard any time by hitting

scenario.pickHint: We tune defaults and infra suggestions based on this choice. You can change it later under /admin.

solo.title: Solo
solo.blurb: One developer, one machine. Personal usage tracker.

team.title: Team
team.blurb: 2–20 developers, shared dashboard. Embed widget on the team site.

infra.pickHint: Recommended options for {{scenario}} are marked. This only affects which deploy guide the dashboard links to — the server runs identically across all options.

native-launchd.title: Native (launchd / systemd)
native-launchd.blurb: Runs as a system service. No container layer. Lightest footprint.

docker-compose.title: Docker Compose
docker-compose.blurb: Server + nginx in one stack. Built-in dashboard included.

kubernetes.title: Kubernetes
kubernetes.blurb: Helm chart, persistent volume for SQLite. For larger orgs.

headless.title: Headless (ingest only)
headless.blurb: No dashboard SPA. Ingest + embed widget endpoints only.

token.title: Paste the bootstrap admin token
token.hint: On first launch the server prints a one-time admin token to its log. Paste it here so the wizard can call admin-scoped endpoints and we can store it in this browser. (You can rotate it later via /admin/tokens.)

embed.title: Add an embed origin
embed.hint: If you plan to embed the widget on a public site (marketing page, team about-page), whitelist the origin now. You can manage origins later under /admin/embeds.
embed.hintBlank: Leave blank to skip — the widget will still work from same-origin pages (your own dashboard).
